notes: This is a new local-only run on the same frozen inputs, seed, model versions, privacy rules and release gates. Stage 6d files and pointer remain unchanged.
Every model invocation is scoped to phase, record, lens and mode. Separate records with identical normalized questions make separate model calls; identical outputs remain possible.
Prompt Guard retains the same 0.5 threshold and raw scores. Original and rewritten inputs are screened separately, with an explicit added-injection-content decision for rewritten text.
Recovered protocol failures remain visible; unavailable and non-generalizable questions are never counted as successful private service.
This repeatedly measured evaluation frame is known. Wilson intervals are descriptive, and cloud quality remains deferred.

R2 changes only the known source-bound provenance grammar bugs. Prompts, per-record caches, models, caps, thresholds, gates and frozen inputs are unchanged. R1 results and archived pointer remain immutable; every R2 inference is fresh.

errorAttempts.scope: Attempt errors remain visible after recovery. These are operational observations; repeated cached errors are not independent new inferences. Unique call hashes and reused observations are reported when available; nonmodel or unidentified attempts are not claimed as unique model errors. The locked no-execution-errors rule concerns final unresolved operations; a recovery requires a new fully validated result. Tokens and latency are already included in aggregate operation stages and must not be added twice.

qualityIntentRepairs.scope: Intent policy blocks and bounded repair attempts are separate from execution errors. Repeated cached observations are not independent new model inferences; latency and tokens already belong to aggregate stages.

spanProtocolAttempts.scope: Literal and pointer modes are local protocol observations, not standalone entity-recall scores. Pointer coordinates and source text are omitted; only window ordinals, counts and hashes are retained. Aggregate operation timings already include this work.

errorAttemptsBefore.scope: The previous run retained final stage errors, not every hidden transport attempt. No recovered-attempt count is invented for the old protocol.

promptGuardComparisons.definition: Raw flag frequency over all compared records is separate from conditional catch rates among available checks. NOT_RUN_AFTER_BLOCK and unavailable rewrites are not classifier negatives or successful service. Effective blocks retain the same original-or-added-content policy.

rewriteCacheEvidence.definition: Separate record IDs have separate invocation scopes even when normalized tasks are identical. Mechanical compilation is reported separately and does not imply a model rewrite call.
